brief:
Israel has imposed restrictions on Beit Ula industrial zone in Hebron, a key Palestinian economic hub in the occupied West Bank, according to Al Jazeera English. The siege measures threaten the livelihoods of Palestinian business owners and workers who depend on the zone's factories and workshops.

The industrial zone has served as a vital source of employment and revenue for the Hebron region. The restrictions are part of broader Israeli measures targeting Palestinian economic activity in occupied territories.
dek: Israel takes measures to crush Palestinian business in the occupied West Bank.
title: Israel sieges Hebron industrial zone, threatening Palestinian businesses
